R1.consumed_inputs: causal B1 inputs; regime = round(motor_speed_rpm__mean / motor_rated_rpm / 0.05) (unchanged B1 bin); no speed -> regime 0

R1.transition: bin changes between consecutive minutes that both have a finite speed ratio -> that minute and the next 9 are TRANSITION; missing-speed minutes are not transitions

R1.persistence: single shared B1 run counter unchanged: a TRANSITION minute continues the run only if a gap or flatline flag is set; otherwise it breaks the run, as a non-steady minute does in B1
R1.unchanged: reference composition, gateway gap, flatline/stuck flags, k, persistence, refractory, diagnosis rules
R1.coverage_output: per-minute diagnostic_status: GATEWAY_GAP | COLLECTING_REFERENCE | NOT_STEADY | TRANSITION | INSUFFICIENT_REGIME_SUPPORT | AVAILABLE

quantities.bt: bearing_temp_c - fluid_temp_c [K] (a temperature rise, not the untransformed bearing temperature)

prototype_definitions.excluded: discharge pressure: pd/(g*H_design) is not normalised pump head (inlet pressure/reference and hydraulic losses vary); own-reference z_pd unchanged after commissioning and in the control
prototype_definitions.status_of_ratios: tentative statistical transfer hypotheses with between-asset uncertainty; not physical performance residuals; not health certification
prototype_definitions.input_validity: installed in channels_available AND observed in the minute (count > 0, finite mean) AND nameplate scale present, finite, > 0; temperature rise needs both temperatures installed and observed; otherwise unsupported (NaN)
prototype_definitions.eligible_minutes: B1 steady, no gateway gap, observed speed ratio in [0.90, 1.05]; without an installed speed channel only control == FIXED_SPEED counts as rated
prototype_definitions.fit: LOAO on the other six train assets; labels select fit windows by excluding every labelled event [onset, end) of a fit asset (end missing -> window end); per asset >= 60 minutes; median of asset medians; scale = max(hypot(1.4826*MAD(asset medians), median within-asset 1.4826*MAD), floor); floors 0.02 (i, pw, q), 0.05 (v), 1.0 K (bt); < 3 fit assets -> unsupported; prior_id = first 16 hex of SHA-256 of the canonical prior JSON
prototype_definitions.provenance: P1 alerts before 24 h: rule_id fleet_prior_cold_start, evidence names the quantities, detail = {reference: fleet_prior, prior_id, quantities with unit, z, fit_assets, prior median/scale}; after commissioning: own-reference B1 alerts with detail reference own_commissioning; P2: rule_id reference_vs_fleet_prior with prior_id, own minutes/median, prior median/scale and z per quantity

metrics.official: detection, class, type, false episodes, excess repeats, composite, benign-window nuisance count
metrics.benign_exposure: nuisance count with total benign-window minutes per asset
metrics.sensor_type_and_channel: emitted type must equal the event type AND the evidence channel must equal sensor_tag (Task002 C0 parse rule); an UNKNOWN never receives credit from its stored alternative
metrics.wrong_specific_causes: first diagnoses with a specific (non-UNKNOWN) wrong type, plus unmatched specific alerts
metrics.unknown: UNKNOWN first diagnoses and UNKNOWN alerts
metrics.specific_diagnosis_coverage: events whose first diagnosis is a specific type / 26
metrics.specific_coverage_comparison: R2 vs an R0 confidence-abstention reference at equal specific coverage: from R0 first diagnoses, relabel as UNKNOWN the n specific first diagnoses with lowest confidence (ties: earlier alert, then asset ID), n = number of R2 abstentions among first diagnoses; compare correct-type and wrong-specific counts -- offline, event-matched DESCRIPTIVE comparator, not a deployable policy
metrics.time_without_diagnosis: minutes per diagnostic_status (R1) and per reference status (all)
metrics.first_correct_type_delay: first assigned burst with the correct emitted type, from detectable_utc; missed listed
metrics.first_useful_diagnosis_delay: as registered: correct emitted type and, for SENSOR events, correct channel; missed listed; reported separately from first_correct_type_delay
metrics.strata: pre_existing events, 0-24 h and later periods reported separately for detection/delay/burden
metrics.r1_coverage_matched: descriptive common-window comparison: R0 alerts at minutes R1 marks AVAILABLE vs R1; not proof of equivalent operational coverage (quality alerts can occur outside AVAILABLE); coverage losses reported explicitly

phase2_E3_evaluation.validation: only for a selected, sealed, gate-passing E3 candidate: one descriptive check vs R0 on PUMP-08/09; never for failed candidates; no retuning afterwards
phase2_E3_evaluation.budget: R0 + R1 + R2 scored; P1/P2 not scored (E4 option A); no further variants
